goal.summary: The macOS leg the last handoff asked for did NOT pass - it produced a 1.8MB PNG of uniform grey noise after a perfectly normal-looking 73s run. Root cause: comfy-cli installs an UNPINNED PyTorch NIGHTLY on --m-series only, and that day's nightly was broken on MPS. Fixed in baefe4c3 (pin stable torch 2.13.0 on darwin + --skip-torch-or-directml), rebuilt as build #5, and BOTH macOS and Windows now pass a full clean install-to-image leg on the real shipped artifacts. Nothing is tagged or published. What remains is the tag move (user approved it, but for a SHA that has since changed) and the release itself.

completed: THE macOS LEG FAILED, AND ONLY LOOKING AT THE IMAGE CAUGHT IT. Build #4 (3cb4a58d) on the rented Mac: engine installed, ComfyUI 0.29.2 stamped, SDXL Realistic 7/7 deps, 'Prompt executed in 73.22 seconds', a normal 832x1024 gallery card, a 1.8MB PNG. The image was uniform grey noise. Reproduced with a second prompt. Every automated signal - logs, timings, file size, UI - said success.

ROOT CAUSE: comfy-cli's MAC_M_SERIES branch is the ONLY one of its GPU branches that installs from the PyTorch nightly index, and it does so with --pre and no version. Read out of its own source on the box (comfy_cli/command/install.py). NVIDIA/AMD/Intel-Arc/CPU all use stable indexes. We passed --m-series and inherited the nightly, so the engine a Mac user got depended on the DATE they installed.

ISOLATED WITH ONE VARIABLE, ComfyUI held at 0.29.2 throughout: torch 2.14.0.dev20260731 (nightly) = grey noise; 2.14.0.dev20260730 (nightly) = correct; 2.13.0 (STABLE) = correct, 73.45s, no speed cost. The 0.29.2 pin is innocent. Corroboration: MPI-391's own section C recorded 'torch 2.14.0.dev20260730' next to its passing generate box - macOS only ever worked by catching a lucky nightly.

CROSS-PLATFORM CHECK: Windows ships a frozen torch 2.13.0+cu130 inside the prebuilt portable archive (read out of the installed engine), Linux resolves stable from PyPI. macOS was the ONLY platform installing an unreleased PyTorch.

FIX baefe4c3 - `torchMac` pin in dev_configs/system_dependencies.json beside the ComfyUI pin; TORCH_MAC exported from routes/platformEngine.js; routes/engine.js step 2b installs the pinned torch on darwin BEFORE comfy-cli runs (so requirements.txt sees it satisfied) AND passes --skip-torch-or-directml at step 3 (so the nightly branch never executes). Both guards deliberate. Windows/Linux paths untouched.

BLAST RADIUS SWEPT: `installArgs` is the ONLY comfy-cli install invocation in the repo; /engine/repair-deps delegates to _runEngineDownload rather than installing torch; /engine/upgrade does not touch torch; no other JS installs torch. Single call site, no twin missed.

key_decisions: macOS torch goes to STABLE, same as Linux - the user's call: 'We can't rely on Nightly.' Measured before deciding: stable 2.13.0 renders correctly at the same speed.
Pinning a known-good NIGHTLY was rejected: PyTorch prunes old nightlies from the index, so the pin would eventually become an install failure.
The fix is darwin-only ON PURPOSE. Linux's unpinned-but-stable torch is the same class at far lower risk; widening the change would mean replicating comfy-cli's CUDA-tag logic for no current defect.
1.3.0 ALL THE WAY, NO BUMP - overwrite until right. 'If we have to do 300 builds, we do 300 builds.' (user)
